seoTitle: Free CrossFit Class in Braintree | CrossFit East Coast
seoDescription: Claim your free CrossFit class at CrossFit East Coast in Braintree, MA. Beginner friendly, coach-led, no experience needed.
headline: Your First CrossFit Class Is *Free*
subhead: Coach-led, beginner-friendly workouts. No experience, no contract, no pressure.
trustBullets: Every class led by a certified coach

steps.title: Claim your spot
steps.text: Fill out the quick form. It takes less than a minute.

steps.title: We text you to book
steps.text: A coach texts you to find a class time that fits your schedule.

steps.title: Come train
steps.text: Show up, meet the coach, and get your first workout in. We scale everything to you.

finalSubtext: Spots in each class are limited so coaches can give you real attention. Claim yours now and we'll text you to book.
notes: First gym built. GHL form FCWeb (inline embed, fields: first name, last name, phone, email) has its own heading, so formHeading/formSubtext are blank. Live at https://crossfit-eastcoast.com/free-crossfit-class (free-class was taken on the domain).
